geometry.locator: OSM way 1174744713 as of 2026-10-25T10:40:01Z; baseline in arXiv:2104.02565 Table 1
geometry.note: OpenStreetMap alone yields at most 'approximate'. The baseline check (to the hall point of this map) is against an official GPS-surveyed figure but cannot make an OSM tracing 'verified' by itself; tolerance 0.3 % (~155 m at 52 km) is the combined error of the published coordinate and the tracing, see the hall record's notes.

method: OpenStreetMap way 1174744713 (building=reactor, 29-vertex footprint, ~1216 m2) kept verbatim. Core label YJ-2 is assigned by matching the order of the six buildings' distances from the published hall coordinate to the order of the published baselines (the OSM ways carry no unit number); this is an assumption, stated here, not a sourced unit number.
name: Yangjiang nuclear power station reactor building, core YJ-2 (OpenStreetMap)
notes: Measured centroid-to-hall distance 52917 m against 52820 m published (+97 m). Farthest-pair check: the centroid separation of YJ-2 and YJ-5 is 725 m with a stable centroid, 1.5 % below the published 736 m (maximum core separation); the pipeline's own centroid routine reports 697 m for the small polygons (a numerical defect), so the check tolerance is 6 %. The published minimum separation (89 m) is not used as a check: the traced twin units are 83.7 m apart (6 % off; the pipeline's routine gives 79 m).

summary.plain: One of the six reactor containment buildings of the Yangjiang nuclear power station, whose antineutrinos JUNO measures; the building is about 52.92 km from the hall.
